title.value: Consensus meta-analysis of genome-wide association studies for Alzheimer’s disease and related dementias
title.quote: Consensus meta-analysis of genome-wide association studies for Alzheimer’s disease and related dementias

design.value: meta-analysis of European-ancestry genome-wide association studies
design.quote: we performed a meta-analysis of European-ancestry genome-wide association studies

n.quote: 128,681 cases or proxy cases of ADRD and 849,833 (proxy) controls

outcomes.name: genome-wide significant (GWS) loci
outcomes.quote: We identified 91 genome-wide significant (GWS) loci ( P ≤ 5 × 10 −8 , defined as ‘tier 1’)

primary_endpoint_status.quote: We identified 91 genetic loci associated with ADRD risk, of which 16 are new and 56 are specifically detected in clinically diagnosed AD cases.
primary_endpoint_status.explanation: The meta-analysis successfully identified 91 genetic loci associated with ADRD risk.

limitations: Genetic correlation with ADRD could not be reliably assessed for most of the 11 neuropathology endophenotypes (NPEs) examined, due to limited study sample sizes and/or low heritability of these traits
Such results are difficult to interpret, considering the limited statistical power of NPE GWASs to detect variants with small effects on ADRD risk.

multiplicity.quote: We considered a significance threshold of P < 9.8 × 10 −4 , corresponding to a Bonferroni correction for 51 tests.
